notes: Official documentation describes query output to a filename with backslash-g as a one-query destination. It also warns that an empty query buffer re-executes the prior query. Construct SELECT without a preceding semicolon, terminate it with backslash-g and a quoted owned output path; never issue an empty-buffer command that repeats prepareSQL. This is documentation-only review; actual interactive output readiness, transaction state and COMMIT protocol remain unexecuted and must be measured.
